definitions.explanation: A protein that acts as a biological catalyst, speeding up chemical reactions in living organisms. Also used in everyday contexts such as health products and cleaning detergents.

examples.japanese: {消化|しょうか}{酵素|こうそ}が{食|た}べ{物|もの}を{分解|ぶんかい}する。
{酵素|こうそ}{入|い}りの{洗剤|せんざい}は{汚|よご}れがよく{落|お}ちる。
examples.english: Detergent with enzymes removes stains well.

examples.japanese: {酵素|こうそ}は{温度|おんど}やpHによって{働|はたら}きが{大|おお}きく{変|か}わるため、{条件|じょうけん}の{管理|かんり}が{重要|じゅうよう}だ。
examples.english: Because enzyme activity varies greatly with temperature and pH, controlling conditions is important.

notes:
{酵素|こうそ} is a scientific term that has become widely known through health products and cleaning supplies marketed to consumers.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {消化|しょうか}{酵素|こうそ} (digestive enzyme)
- {酵素|こうそ}{反応|はんのう} (enzyme reaction)
- {酵素|こうそ}ドリンク (enzyme drink — a health product)
- {酵素|こうそ}{入|い}り (containing enzymes)

In Japan, {酵素|こうそ}ドリンク (enzyme drinks) and {酵素|こうそ}サプリ (enzyme supplements) are popular health products. The word is also commonly seen on packaging for enzyme-containing laundry detergents and cleaning products.
